title: an undated fact on a person with two events of its type is a conflict, never a silent drop
line: assert_facts leaves an undated death fact unasserted when the person carries two death events, exactly as it already did for two births; the checklist raises the multi-event conflict for every type, in its own words, and a second conflict of its own naming the record whose fact fits none of them, so nothing is dropped without a word

steps.say: Robert Edgar Davidson carries one Death event already, the file's own claim
a second Death event planted on him: the harness's own stand-in for a real second dated record, since the harness holds no such pair for him
a record attached on the owner's word, no step citing it: his father's Ohio death index page, whose own Death fact carries no date

expect.why: no step cited the record; a card on arrival for the record's subject, his

steps.say: the owner accepts him on it: the record's undated death fits neither of his two events, and nothing is guessed

expect.why: no third event guessed at, and the file's own claim is still the key fact's value: the record's own undated Death asserts nothing
the checklist raises the multi-event conflict for a death, not only a birth

question.detail_has: fits none of your 2 death events
